evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically through growth: 12.0 → 16.0 → 20.7 → 27.2 ppm, after purging down to ~6 ppm
Tube pressure creeping up 3.044 → 3.209 Torr at constant Ar 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure/O2 rise is not flow-driven
Temperature holding at setpoint 750 °C, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: A pump-down/flow-off static leak-rate test (or Ar step change) to separate air ingress from exhaust restriction, plus post-run characterization of the sample.
